candidates.explanation: After the password is changed via the reset link, existing sessions for the user are never invalidated. Other flows (e.g. AuthService.update) call sessionService.deleteByUserIdWithExclude, but resetPassword doesn't call sessionService.deleteByUserId. A device that is already signed in therefore keeps its session and can still renew its login with refreshToken.

fix.description: After updating the password in resetPassword, delete all of the user's sessions by calling `await this.sessionService.deleteByUserId({ userId: user.id });`.
